hebrewText: וְ/אָנ֥וּ וְ/אָבְל֖וּ פְּתָחֶ֑י/הָ וְ/נִקָּ֖תָה לָ/אָ֥רֶץ תֵּשֵֽׁב

tokens.bdb: an opening (literally), i.e. door (gate) or entrance way
tokens.kjv: door, entering (in), entrance (-ry), gate, opening, place.

tokens.bdb: to be (or make) clean (literally or figuratively); by implication (in an adverse sense) to be bare, i.e. extirpated
tokens.kjv: acquit [idiom] at all, [idiom] altogether, be blameless, cleanse, (be) clear(-ing), cut off, be desolate, be free, be (hold) guiltless, be (hold) innocent, [idiom] by no means, be quit, be (leave) unpunished, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] wholly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be  clean ; by implication  to be bare
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be  clean ; by implication  to be bare
tokens.explanation: to be  clean ; by implication  to be bare
tokens.explanationEn: to be  clean ; by implication  to be bare

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.
